description: Commander deck building ratios by bracket and strategy
source: Mythic Vault wisdom + EDHREC data + community consensus

1.description: Precon power, beginner friendly, minimal tutors/fast mana

lands.reason: Higher land count for consistency, fewer cheap rocks

tutors.reason: Minimal tutoring, high CMC tutors only

combos.reason: Accidental combos only, not primary wincon

2.description: Optimized precon, focused strategy, some staples

ramp.reason: Mix of creatures and artifacts, some 1-2 CMC rocks

card_draw.reason: Card advantage engines, more reliable draw

removal.reason: Mix of spot removal and flexible answers

tutors.reason: A few tutors for key pieces, still high CMC

combos.reason: Possible win condition but not primary focus

3.description: High power, staples in every slot, multiple wincons

lands.reason: Efficient ramp package allows lower land count

ramp.reason: Fast mana rocks (Sol Ring, Mana Crypt, etc.)

card_draw.reason: Strong card advantage engines, multiple sources

tutors.reason: Tutors for combo pieces or key answers

4.description: cEDH fringe, optimized combos, fast wins

lands.reason: Low CMC curve, fetches, shocks, duals

ramp.reason: All fast mana available, dorks + rocks

card_draw.reason: Draw your combo as fast as possible

board_wipes.reason: Less relevant in fast meta, mostly creature wipes

tutors.reason: Tutor for combo pieces every game

protection.reason: Free counterspells, Pact of Negation, etc.

removal.reason: Stopping opponent wins while setting up yours

board_wipes.reason: Too slow for cEDH, spot removal preferred

tutors.reason: Tutor every game, multiple lines to victory

protection.reason: Free spells, Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship

tribal.description: Creature type synergy (Dragons, Elves, Zombies, etc.)

adjustments.reason: More creatures for tribal synergy, less room for interaction

combo.description: Combo-focused deck, tutor for pieces and win

adjustments.reason: More combos, tutors to find them, protection to resolve them

aggro.description: Low curve, fast damage, weenies and pump

adjustments.reason: Lower curve needs fewer lands, more creatures

control.description: Reactive, answers everything, win late game

adjustments.reason: More interaction, fewer threats, win with card advantage
More ramp for big threats, fewer answers
Protect commander, load it with buffs
Maximize spell count for triggers

reanimator.description: Graveyard recursion, cheat big creatures into play

adjustments.reason: Fill graveyard, reanimate threats

stax.description: Lock opponents out, prevent them from playing

adjustments.reason: Lock pieces, protect them, win slowly

aristocrats.description: Sacrifice creatures for value and drain

adjustments.reason: More sacrifice fodder, draw from death triggers

tokens.description: Create many creature tokens, go wide strategy

adjustments.reason: Token generators and anthem effects, go wide and pump the team

tempo.description: Play threats while disrupting opponents, maintain board advantage

adjustments.reason: Balance threats and answers, stay ahead on board

lifegain.description: Gain life and leverage life total as resource

adjustments.reason: Life gain triggers and payoffs, stabilize then win

mill.description: Win by decking opponents, graveyard disruption

adjustments.reason: Mill opponents out, minimal creature presence

group_hug.description: Help everyone, then win with political advantage or combo

adjustments.reason: Help everyone draw and ramp, then leverage advantage

group_slug.description: Punish opponents for playing the game

adjustments.reason: Symmetrical damage effects, drain everyone slowly

lands_matter.description: Landfall triggers, extra land drops, lands as win condition

adjustments.reason: More lands for triggers, extra land drop effects
Maximize artifacts for synergy triggers
Maximize enchantments for constellation/enchantress triggers
Many planeswalkers, protect them, control board

midrange.description: Flexible gameplan, value creatures, adapt to meta

adjustments.reason: Well-rounded deck, good creatures and interaction

self_mill.description: Mill yourself to fuel graveyard strategies

adjustments.reason: Fill graveyard quickly, leverage it as second hand

discard.description: Make opponents discard, benefit from discard triggers

adjustments.reason: Strip opponent's hands, generate value from discard

cycling.description: Cycle cards for value, cycling payoffs

adjustments.reason: Many cycling cards, payoffs trigger on each cycle

go_wide.description: Many creatures, overrun effects, go wide strategy

adjustments.reason: Flood board with creatures, pump team and swing

pillowfort.description: Prevent attacks, taxing effects, defensive strategy

adjustments.reason: Prevent combat damage, control with taxes, win slowly

turbo_fog.description: Fog effects every turn, prevent all combat damage

adjustments.reason: Prevent all damage, draw cards, win with alternate wincon
Many small disruptive creatures, taxing effects
Infect creatures, pump them, 10 poison kills

wheels.description: Wheel effects, discard and draw 7, graveyard/hand synergies

adjustments.reason: Wheel to refill hands, trigger Nekusar/waste-not effects

card_type_distribution.description: Rough distribution of card types in a typical deck
card_type_distribution.note: These are guidelines, not strict rules. Commander + deck building ratio cards = ~60-70 cards. Remaining 30-40 are 'flex slots' for strategy-specific cards.

typical_breakdown.flex_description: Strategy-specific cards: creatures for tribal, spells for spellslinger, stax pieces for stax, etc.

bracket_2_tribal.description: The Ur-Dragon tribal dragons deck, bracket 2
bracket_2_tribal.reasoning: Base bracket 2 ratios + tribal modifier: +10 creatures (dragons), -2 removal. 23 dragons provide tribal synergy, Ur-Dragon cost reduction enables big plays.

bracket_4_combo.reasoning: Base bracket 4 ratios + combo modifier: +3 combos (Sage of Hours, Magistrate's Scepter, etc.), +4 tutors, +4 protection. High tutor count finds combo pieces.

bracket_3_control.reasoning: Base bracket 3 ratios + control modifier: +7 removal, +3 board wipes, +6 card draw, -10 creatures. Shorikai IS the creature, rest is answers and card advantage.

usage_notes: These ratios are GUIDELINES not strict rules
Commander identity affects available cards (color pie considerations)
Budget affects card choices (Mana Crypt vs Mind Stone)
Playgroup affects power level (kitchen table vs cEDH)
Strategy modifiers STACK with bracket base ratios
Flex slots (30-40 cards) are where strategy shines
Total cards must equal 99 + 1 commander (or 98 + 2 partner commanders)
These ratios come from EDHREC data analysis and community wisdom
v3 AI model should learn PATTERNS not memorize specific cards
